subject.title: [model-catalog] FsSafeError: directory changed during operation — catalog write races with reader, loops every ~1min

question: Is deterministic fs-safe private-store boundary proof in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102204 sufficient to close this production warning-loop issue without live Anthropic/systemd logs?
rationale: The source path and candidate fix are narrow, but the original production gateway scenario has not been rerun after the fix, so maintainer proof policy decides whether the PR can close this report.

options.title: Accept Deterministic Boundary Proof
options.body: Proceed with the candidate PR after exact-head gates because it repairs the private-store write boundary and sidecar read ordering shown by source inspection.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Anthropic/systemd gateway logs and sidecar file evidence before merging the candidate PR and closing this issue.

options.title: Reject The Candidate Shape
options.body: Close the candidate PR and keep this issue open for a replacement fix if maintainers decide retry-plus-queue coordination is not the right boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Deterministic Boundary Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with the candidate PR after exact-head gates because it repairs the private-store write boundary and sidecar read ordering shown by source inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned to this issue and is the strongest current-history owner for the touched model-catalog/gateway cache files.
